Lü Bu seized control of Xu Province from Liu Bei in 196, so Zhang Liao most likely received the appointment in that year. By calculation, if Zhang Liao was 28 years old (by East Asian age reckoning) in 196, his birth year should be around 169. Zhang Liao's biography in the Sanguozhi recorded that he died in the same year after his subordinates defeated the Wu general Lü Fan at the Battle of Dongkou in late 222.
